source_policy.method: Stable k=4 unsupervised clusters, measured distinctness, and clean-room source review.
rules: Full-data cluster labels are not independent held-out truth.
No prototype is a universal winner and no topic, industry, population, benchmark, or ID tie-break is allowed.
Production selection derives a qualitative-semantic whole-video profile internally and permits no caller prototype or numeric target controls.

variation_boundaries: Concrete tokens may vary within intent_intervals and mandatory quality gates.
Content and legibility may narrow an interval but may not change the selected prototype identity.
exclusions: No mood, industry, premium, or universal-superiority inference.
No copied source HTML, CSS, SVG, or source-specific composition.

counterexample.basis: Different measured cluster intervals in the same normalized feature space.
